contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (500.00) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (500.00) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (500.00)
contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row sums to 500.00 = the schedule's printed page subtotal (500.00) = the schedule's printed Total Contributions Received (500.00) = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Column A (500.00). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 500.00 because this is the filer's FIRST report of the 2010 cycle (line 3 beginning balance is a written '0'), so period and cumulative coincide; the anchor used is still Column A and Column B was never summed as an increment.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (288.37) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's printed 'Subtotal for this page' (288.37) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (288.37)
expenditures.detail: 5 Schedule B rows sum to 21.52 + 32.06 + 74.73 + 32.06 + 128.00 = 288.37 exactly = the printed page subtotal (288.37) = the printed Total Expenditures Received (288.37) = the cover's Column A (288.37). That closure is also what fixes row 3, whose cents could be read 74.73 or 74.13 at 200 dpi: 288.37 minus the other four rows (213.64) leaves 74.73, and arithmetic closure outranks the glyph. Column B YTD 288.37 is identical (first report of the cycle) and was not summed as an increment. The p2 balance ladder closes on its own terms: line 3 (0) + line 4 (500.00) = line 5 (500.00); 500.00 - 288.37 = line 7 close (211.63).

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither schedule prints an in-kind column and no row is annotated in-kind, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the identical sums (500.00 / 288.37) and both close on Column A. The 128.00 'Mileage' row is a cash reimbursement line the filer wrote against 'Self', not an in-kind entry, and is counted as cash exactly as the filer's own subtotal counts it.
itemized.escalation_note: (1) p4 row 3 amount — 900 dpi row crops plus the page's own closure settled it at 74.73 (the filer's 7s carry a crossbar-like flick that reads as a 1 at 200 dpi); the schedule's printed 288.37 subtotal is what decides it, not the glyph. (2) p4 vendor names rows 2-4 — a 700 dpi crop of the Name column rendered 'Carol's Copies', 'Monogram Station' and 'Carol's Copies' legibly enough to transcribe at medium confidence; no name was guessed from context.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'Jeffrey R. Buhman' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 county_static listing grouped by office); the page face governs. Party printed 'Rep.' (verbatim); residence city Orem, UT. legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 COVER ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election' checked, amendment 'No', signed 6-4-10, clerk stamp JUN 4 PM 2:42), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed header, at the expected p2 ordinal), p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A. ⚠ THE COVER'S 'Office Seeking' CELL IS ENTIRELY BLANK on this filing (as are the street-address and phone cells) — the office 'County Attorney' comes from the acquisition channel's path/listing, NOT from this page; no office was inferred onto the page face here. The filer's OTHER 2010 filing (0989f448, 10-26-10) does print 'County Attorney' in that cell. THE SAME-FILER COVER CHAIN HOLDS EXACTLY: this report's line 7 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period' is 211.63, and the later report's line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' prints 211.63; likewise this report's figures (500.00 contributions / 288.37 expenditures) are exactly the difference between the two reports' year-to-date columns (900.00 - 400.00 = 500.00; 288.37 - 0 = 288.37). That is reported as an OBSERVATION only — no figure in this record was derived by differencing two covers, and each filing was transcribed strictly on its own terms.
